{{Quote|I've ordered all the fleets in the region to converge on the system. A planetary shield envelops the planet, projected from the small moon orbiting it.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Game">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>}}
The '''Thurra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> 

[[Thurra]] was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the system. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sivvi]], and by the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Enenpa]] and its forty moons.<ref name="GatORW" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2007]] reference book [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] incorrectly treats the Thule and Thurra systems as separate locations. It also incorrectly places [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in the Thurra system. Later in the book, Dromund Kaas is placed in the [[Dromund system]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
